# sequential-analysis

> Mathematical sequential inference: statistical tests, confidence sequences,
> change detection, filtering and forecasting. Import: sequential_analysis.

This is the repository's curated entry point. The existing published
[docs/llms.txt](docs/llms.txt) and generated site llms-full.txt retain their own
documentation build flow. This file does not replace either or promise AI
indexing, recommendations or automatic ingestion.

## Start here

- [Plain-language overview](docs/overview.md): use cases, method selection, inputs/outputs, limits and FAQ.
- [Обзор на русском](docs/overview.ru.md): назначение, выбор методов, входные данные, результаты, ограничения и частые вопросы.
- [User guide](docs/guide/index.md): questions explained with runnable examples.
- [Method selection](docs/choosing.md): choose a method by the statistical question.
- [FAQ](docs/guide/faq.md): installation, licensing and use.

## Technical sources

- [README](README.md): scope and repository status.
- [Coding guidance](AGENTS.md) and [contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): current commands and compatibility.
- [Version source](src/sequential_analysis/version.py): checkout version; compare with your installed release.
- [Run reference](docs/reference/run.md): execution and observation delivery.
- [Method catalogue](docs/methods.md): implemented procedure families.
- [Checkpoint formats](docs/spec.md): persistence semantics.
- [TypeScript executor](docs/typescript.md): supported cross-language behavior.
- [Tests](tests/): independent-reference and behavioral checks.

## Published documentation

- [Documentation site](https://andre-a-no.github.io/sequential-analysis/)
- [Published llms index](https://andre-a-no.github.io/sequential-analysis/llms.txt)
- [Generated full documentation](https://andre-a-no.github.io/sequential-analysis/llms-full.txt)

Every statistical guarantee has a method-specific meaning and assumptions.
Development source, released packages and the deployed site may differ; record
the revision/version when reporting behavior.
